text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali confers with Prime Minister Hamed Karoui and recommends appropriate measures to modernise the administration and to safeguard the next season's olive oil crop.
- Banks to finance the modernisation programme of 30 firms for an investment of 60 million dinars. Bonus paid by the state will be 7.1 million dinars.
- President Ben Ali receives Tunisian businessmen organisation head Hedi Jilani. Says action for lower prices is a national responsibility.
- Dates output during the season 1996-1997 put at 65,000 tonnes, and exports forecast at 20,000 tonnes.
- Tunisia, Japan discuss cooperation in the fishing sector. ($=0.97 dinar)
